text:
Priya: Quick sync — Tallinn private pilot asks for a 99.9% p95 inference latency SLA on the chat endpoint and HSM-backed key storage. We need to decide what to commit for Dedicated vs Private. Can runtime/infra/security align on acceptance criteria and sequencing?

Lina: For runtime: 8k context, p95 200-350ms depends on model variant. If they need strict 200ms we should propose a smaller model or plan for aggressive quant + sharding.

Dev: From infra: Dedicated capacity + reserved network egress are required to make p95 stable. Also prewarm agents for steady qps. We need committed slots and autoscale headroom.

Sam: Security: HSM integration timeline? We can do KMS today, HSM via partner (3–4 weeks). Also need threat model review for private control plane.

Marco: SRE note: we'll require a 72h soak on staging with traffic replay and a canary rollout window. Also alerting thresholds and a playbook for graceful degrade to lower-cost model.

Priya: Ok concrete proposal: acceptance criteria draft — 1) p95 <= 350ms for configured model at pilot qps, 2) failover path to compatible model with p95 <= 600ms, 3) KMS in week 0, HSM availability flagged as week 3+, 4) canary + 72h soak, 5) runbook and SLO dashboard available. Thoughts? :memo:

Lina: +1 to the list. Add a performance regression test with the customer's prompt set as gating. We should also include KV cache warmup for prefixes.

Dev: I'll enumerate infra commits: reserved GPU slots, network egress rule, prewarm policy (min-replicas). Prototype config snippet:
```yaml
service: tallinn-chat
model: rdx-4b-low-latency
min_replicas: 3
prewarm: true
canary: 5% for 4h
qos: p95_target_ms: 350
```

Sam: We need an approval path for HSM keys + compliance checklist. Priya, can you confirm whether Tallinn requires FIPS certs / attestations?

Priya: they asked for 'HSM-backed keys' and audit logs. I'll confirm FIPS and report back by EOD.

Alex: I can own the Dedicated capacity commit if PM approves. I'll draft the capacity PR and cost estimate.

Marco: Once Alex posts PR, I'll schedule a canary window and set the alerts. Also will add synthetic traffic to validate p95.

Priya: Action items summary: Priya -> confirm FIPS & audit asks; Alex -> capacity PR + cost estimate; Dev -> infra config + prod/network checklist; Lina -> perf gating harness & KV warmup plan; Sam -> HSM approval path & compliance checklist; Marco -> canary soak plan and alerts. Target: pilot acceptance review next Tue 10:00 PT.

Dev: noted. I'll start infra ticket and link it to the PR.

deploy-bot: Created ticket INFRA-4124 (reserved slots + prewarm) and linked to this thread.

Priya: Thanks all — will collate and share a one-pager for the customer. :rocket:
